steps.en: Court updates arrive through one generic channel, not a warrant-specific one
steps.id: Update dari court diterima lewat satu jalur umum, bukan khusus warrant
steps.why_en: No warrant of arrest channel or message type exists, only a general notice update.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada jalur atau jenis pesan khusus warrant of arrest, hanya update notice umum.

steps.en: Notice stage is overwritten from the update, but not checked, and no warrant stage exists
steps.id: Stage notice ditimpa dari update, tapi tidak divalidasi dan belum ada stage warrant
steps.why_en: Stage can be changed but is not validated, and there is no warrant-specific stage.
steps.why_id: Stage bisa diubah, namun tidak dicek dan belum ada stage khusus warrant.

steps.en: The court ruling outcome is recorded on the notice
steps.id: Hasil putusan court dicatat di notice
steps.why_en: There is nowhere and no process to keep the adjudication outcome on the notice.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat atau proses untuk menyimpan hasil adjudication di notice.

steps.en: Notice amount payable is updated from the court update
steps.id: Amount payable notice ikut ter-update dari update court

steps.en: Follow-up of the warrant of arrest from the notice
steps.id: Tindak lanjut warrant of arrest dari notice
steps.why_en: No screen or process for warrant follow-up; the warrant search has nothing behind it.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau proses tindak lanjut warrant; pencarian warrant tidak ada tindak lanjutnya.
